# @crownone/ui

> Shared React Native / Expo component library for Crown One apps: themed components with light and dark mode, grouped lists, wallet formatters, a theme system (`ThemeProvider`, `useTheme`) with translatable built-in text, and Inter typography. iOS, Android and Web.

Import everything from the package root (`import { StyledButton, useTheme } from "@crownone/ui"`). The app must be wrapped in `ThemeProvider` and load the Inter fonts under the names `inter_light`, `inter_regular`, `inter_medium`, `inter_semiBold` and `inter_bold`. Read colors from `useTheme().colors`; never hardcode them. Icons are MaterialCommunityIcons names.

In an installed project, read `node_modules/@crownone/ui/llms-full.txt` instead of the links below: it matches the installed version.

## Docs

- [Full usage reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hammadev/crownone-ui/main/llms-full.txt): rules, setup, theme tokens, and every component's props with examples
- [README](https://github.com/hammadev/crownone-ui#readme): human docs with rendered light and dark previews of every component
- [Claude Code skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hammadev/crownone-ui/main/skills/crownone-ui/SKILL.md): drop-in skill for apps that use the library

## Components

- Typography and media: StyledText, StyledImage, StyledIcon, AlphabetAvatar
- Actions: StyledButton, StyledChip, StyledTabs
- Inputs: StyledTextField, SearchBar, StyledDropdown, StyledCheckbox, StyledRadioButton
- Feedback: StatusCard, EmptyListComponent, LoadingComponent, Skeleton, FieldError
- Layout: StyledCard, SummaryValueCard, OrDivider, BottomActionsBar, BlurModalBackdrop
- Lists: DateGroupedList, AlphabetGroupedList
- Utilities: formatCashWallet, formatPointsWallet, useSinglePress, getFieldErrorMessage
- Optional entry points: `@crownone/ui/receipt` (ShareableReceipt, useShareReceipt), `@crownone/ui/otp` (OtpBoxInput)
